verdict.rationale: The only evidence of recurring scheduling is a passing mention that the hosted MCP server exposes snapshot 'schedule' tools, a narrow recurring backup job. Neon Functions are listed with 'triggers', but nothing shows these are time-based or recurring rather than one-off invocations. Branch TTLs are one-off expiry, not a recurring schedule. missing for 10: documented general-purpose cron or recurring triggers for Functions or workflows, scheduling docs beyond a single tool-list mention, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
